classification.difficultyReason: Read horizontal then vertical positions from a labelled unit grid, assigning signs and recognising zero coordinates for points on the axes.

content.prompt: Give the coordinates of points $A$ to $G$.

spec.description: Unit square grid from x = −6 to 8 and y = −5 to 7. Positive-direction axis arrows, x and y labels, and numbered ticks x = −5 to 7 and y = −4 to 6. Source red point markers become ordinary black markers under house style; their positions and labels are unchanged.
spec.answerVisibility: The labelled points are permanent question givens. Their coordinate pairs appear only in the answers.

answer.worked:
Read the horizontal coordinate first and the vertical coordinate second. A point on the vertical axis has horizontal coordinate $0$; a point on the horizontal axis has vertical coordinate $0$.

$$\begin{aligned}A&=(4,4)\\B&=(3,-1)\\C&=(0,4)\\D&=(-5,0)\\E&=(-3,-3)\\F&=(-5,5)\\G&=(5,-4)\end{aligned}$$
